from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w - 2):
            if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] == grid[r][c + 2] and grid[r][c + 1] == bg:
                out[r][c + 1] = 2
    return out
'''

def mkgrid(h,w,bg,color,rows):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,cs in rows.items():
        for c in cs:g[r][c]=color
    return g

d1=mkgrid(9,21,3,8,{3:[4,6,8,10,12,14,16],7:[7,9,11,13]})
e1=[row[:] for row in d1]
for r,cs in {3:[4,6,8,10,12,14,16],7:[7,9,11,13]}.items():
    for c in cs[:-1]:e1[r][c+1]=2
print('demo1 matches:', transform(d1)==e1)
rows2={1:[8,10,12,14],2:[6,8,10,12,14,16,18],5:[13,15,17,19],6:[13,15,17],7:[8,10,12,14,16,18],8:[3,5],9:[11,13,15],11:[3,5,7,9],15:[3,5,7,9,11,13],16:[3,5,7,9]}
d2=mkgrid(17,21,5,6,rows2)
e2=[row[:] for row in d2]
for r,cs in rows2.items():
    for c in cs[:-1]:e2[r][c+1]=2
